text:
alex: Heads-up — we need a concise on-call friendly span naming + attr checklist for LLM requests. Ops wants something they can grep quickly during incidents.

maria: +1. prefer short span names not long phrase-based ones. suggest operation-centric like `inference.request` or `inference.generate`.

sam: I still like including a light verb so you can grep for errors: `inference.request` + `redwood.stage` attr. keep the name stable across variants.

jen: proposal draft: span.name = `inference.request` (always). attrs: `llm.model`, `llm.model_variant`, `llm.qconfig`, `llm.input_tokens`, `llm.output_tokens`, `llm.kvcache_hits`, `redwood.route`, `redwood.quota_bucket`, `redwood.fallback_reason` (if any).

alex: +1 to fixed name. we don't want exploding span names in traces. but we do need a short human label for dashboards — maybe `inference.request.v1` as a semantic version attr instead of in the name.

sam: agree. also add `llm.request_type` enum: `generation`, `embedding`, `rerank`, `chat`. that helps sampling rules.

maria: sampling/export rules: sample all errors + 1% of successful `embedding` calls (super high volume). For `generation` sample 5% success, 100% of latencies > 1s. We'll rely on attrs to filter.

jen: note on PII: token counts are ok as ints; do NOT export raw prompt text to OTLP sink by default. flag `redwood.include_prompt` = `true|false` toggled per customer workspace. default false.

telemetry-bot: reminder: created PR draft at https://git.redwood/telemetry/span-checklists-llm — please review. :robot_face:

alex: small code snippet for the handbook (on-call):
```
span.name = "inference.request"
span.attributes = {
  "llm.model": "gptx-7b",
  "llm.model_variant": "gptx-7b-q4_0",
  "llm.qconfig": "q4_0",
  "llm.request_type": "generation",
  "llm.input_tokens": 23,
  "llm.output_tokens": 48,
  "llm.kvcache_hits": 2,
  "redwood.route": "dedicated-us-east-1",
  "redwood.quota_bucket": "tier-A"
}
```

maria: suggest renaming `llm.kvcache_hits` -> `llm.kv_cache_hits`? underscores clearer in dashboards. also we need `llm.cache_hit_rate` (float) for aggregated metrics.

sam: +1 for `kv_cache`. also add `redwood.model_stability` attr: `stable|fallback|experimental` so runbooks can show if a fallback model was used during an incident.

jen: retention/export notes for playbook:
- OTLP exporter to long-term storage only for traces flagged `error=true` or `redwood.incident_trace=true`.
- Metric counters (input/output tokens) aggregated and stored, raw traces sampled per rules above.
- Strip prompt text out when forwarding to third-party exporters unless `redwood.include_prompt=true` AND customer consented.

alex: UX for console: when you click a slow trace, surface `llm.model_variant`, `llm.qconfig`, `redwood.route`, and `redwood.fallback_reason` at top. keep span name hidden from user-facing label.

telemetry-bot: note: added sampling policy `embedding-success-1pct`, `generation-success-5pct`, `latency-gt-1s-100pct` to staging config.

maria: final ask — make a short regex for alerts: `span.name:inference.request AND llm.request_type:generation AND llm.output_tokens>1000` to catch runaway generations.

sam: and an alert on cache degradation: `rate(llm.kv_cache_hits[5m]) / rate(llm.input_tokens[5m])` low threshold -> page.

jen: I'll fold into the PR and add a small on-call card with quick grep commands and example `otelcli` queries. want to ship by EOD.

alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup: merge when green.
